source.description:
## Symptom

Real Pi AgentSession + full ChainRun over /home/dawid/projects/mercury/infra ends at coordinator-entry with:

  agent_end ok, 2 messages, pi_session=<uuid>
  runtime ESCALATION: reducer produced no intents and chain not closed — blocked

Reproduces identically under `--specialist-json required` (pi_session=01a01779-c305-7ec9-a71d-fdd83330784b) and `--specialist-json off` (pi_session=01a0177c-3e6a-79d5-890c-ad16416f4597). Both runs preserved under experiments/agentsession-sre-chain-vertical-slice/.chain-runs/sre-smoke-20260819T004406Z/ and .../sre-baseline-20260819T004651Z/.

## Reducer contract vs observed behavior

src/chain/reducer.ts:65-74 satisfies coordinator-entry only when `coordinator.decision` evidence lands. roles/chain-coordinator.md:1-25 instructs the coordinator model to `evidence_publish` one `coordinator.decision` body then post one work.turn channel message. In both smokes the model returned agent_end after ~500ms with no tool calls (2 messages = user prompt + assistant text). No evidence, no channel message, no scheduler intent for advisors. Reducer honestly refuses to advance.

## Diagnostic gap

Need the raw session transcript (assistant text + tool list Pi actually presented) to determine which of:
1. tool registration path in agents/bridge.ts / specialist-bridge.ts is failing under CLI main.ts path
2. system prompt assembly is not delivering the role prompt intact
3. model behind opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash proxy returns without invoking tools
4. execution.output_type=synthesis compilation is short-circuiting the tool loop

scripts/smoke_bridge_verbose.ts already dumps SESSION MESSAGES + tool list; reuse to isolate.

## Scope discipline

This is a runtime-integration defect visible in the current experiment code post-#71 merge (cef3cf8). It reproduces without any Specialist JSON cognition. It belongs to the NEXT implementation workstream (PREPARE + ActivationSupervisor + result-contract validation), not this reconciliation campaign. Do NOT fix by hardening coordinator prompts alone — the underlying seam is what PR #70 called out: prompt-owned orchestration is fragile.

## Evidence artefacts

- experiments/agentsession-sre-chain-vertical-slice/.chain-runs/sre-smoke-20260819T004406Z/run-sre-c84b2/forensics/events.jsonl
- experiments/agentsession-sre-chain-vertical-slice/.chain-runs/sre-baseline-20260819T004651Z/run-sre-cff92/forensics/events.jsonl
- both chain-progress.json show coordinator-entry produced_result, 5 downstream steps waiting

## No target mutation

git -C /home/dawid/projects/mercury/infra status confirms only pre-existing chore/py_backend-smml.4-otel-mcp-ghcr-pin diff (unrelated). No commits, no pushes, no config edits triggered by the smoke.

Patch is uncommitted in worktree branch web/full-specialist-json-loader-2026-08-18. Handoff bundle: experiments/agentsession-sre-chain-vertical-slice/handoff/2026-08-19-real-infra-smoke/. See BRIEF.md §5 + patches/current-src/scheduler.ts.

source.description:
## Symptom

Real smoke against mercury/infra with SRE Specialist JSONs whose execution.model resolves to a Pi custom-provider ID (e.g. commandcode/deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash) fails at dispatch:

  dispatch threw: model not found: commandcode/deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash

## Root cause

experiments/agentsession-sre-chain-vertical-slice/src/agents/bridge.ts:127-133 and src/agents/specialist-bridge.ts:94-101 both do:

  const primary = getModel(provider, id);  // from @earendil-works/pi-ai/compat

pi-ai/compat's getModel only resolves *built-in* providers (getBuiltinModel). Providers declared in ~/.pi/agent/models.json under `providers.<name>` (baseUrl + apiKey + api + authHeader + models[]) are custom — pi-coding-agent's own CLI loads them via core/model-runtime.js (class ModelRuntime), not via pi-ai/compat.

Built-in providers pi-ai/compat resolves in this env: anthropic, deepseek, google, nvidia, opencode-go, zai. Custom providers registered in ~/.pi/agent/models.json (this machine: commandcode, nano-gpt, nvidia, qwencloud, zai) are invisible to bridge.ts.

## Repro

  bun scripts/inspect-specialist.ts --repo <target> --name sre-coordinator
    -> resolves model string commandcode/deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash (compiler passes it through)
  bun src/cli/main.ts --repo <target> --specialist-json required --incident ...
    -> step.failed 'dispatch threw: model not found: commandcode/deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash'
    -> reducer escalates chain

Test evidence: .chain-runs/sre-smoke-v2-20260819T010347Z/run-sre-85e55/forensics/events.jsonl

## Fix direction

bridge.ts + specialist-bridge.ts should route through ModelRuntime (or an equivalent adapter that unifies built-in + custom providers). Options:

1. Instantiate ModelRuntime from @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent, expose a wrapper getModelUnified(provider, id) that checks built-in first then custom via ModelRuntime.getAvailable(...).
2. Preflight: at bridge init, read ~/.pi/agent/models.json, and for each custom provider call pi-ai's registerProvider(...) (if exposed) with its baseUrl/api/apiKey/models.
3. Change Specialist JSON convention to only use built-in provider IDs (loses commandcode/nano-gpt/qwencloud gateway wrapping — arguably out of scope for the runtime to enforce).

Preferred: (1) — matches what Pi CLI does natively.

## Scope discipline

Same as xtrm-pq1.1: this is a runtime-integration defect, not a Specialist JSON cognition defect. Belongs to the next implementation workstream (PREPARE + capability resolver + activation supervisor), not this reconciliation campaign.
source.notes: Proven fix: src/agents/model-resolver.ts (NEW, 47 lines) — falls through pi-ai/compat built-ins to ~/.pi/agent/models.json catalog. commandcode/deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash resolved end-to-end across all 6 chain steps today. Also required: src/chain/topology.ts DEFAULT_MODEL swapped to commandcode/deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash (opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash starved reviewer in a prior run). Patches in worktree branch web/full-specialist-json-loader-2026-08-18. Handoff: experiments/agentsession-sre-chain-vertical-slice/handoff/2026-08-19-real-infra-smoke/patches/current-src/{model-resolver,topology}.ts.
source.title: bridge/specialist-bridge use pi-ai/compat getModel — misses custom providers from ~/.pi/agent/models.json (e.g. commandcode)
